verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's Flow is described as letting merchants "accept payments using customizable components – all through one simple integration," and it is offered as an option alongside the Hosted Payment Page rather than as a redirect. Flow for Mobile extends this to native iOS and Android SDKs, and public keys are documented for client-side channels. The evidence is mostly product-marketing level, though. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how components are embedded and styled, explicit statement that Flow renders inline on the merchant's page, independent or hands-on corroboration.
